directive:
Revise specialization v1 in place while preserving the common-uniform nested-rollout kernel, the aggregate-coefficient ellipsoid, the subset-intersection operator K, the isotypic block reduction, and the exact node-weight spectral saddle as the field-level headline. Do not change the topic, strengthen the schedule/randomization assumptions, or encode an optimizer/conclusion into an assumption.

Treat the D-0.5 dependency objection as fatal to the current asymptotic inference branch. Pairwise non-independence of unit outcome vectors does not define a dependency graph. Remove D and d_max as currently defined, ass:sparse-dependency-degree, thm:design-clt as a theorem, and the Gaussian/Wald conclusion of thm:conservative-wald-coverage; do not “repair” them by imposing a stronger primitive-support-overlap condition. If retained at all, restate the CLT as an open-ended question whose missing premise is a genuine setwise dependency graph. Also remove bounded-outcomes and variance-nondegeneracy assumptions if they have no remaining theorem consumer.

Replace the invalid Wald result by an exact finite-sample robust inference theorem using the existing covariance certificate: for every schedule in C_{n,β}(B,ω), unbiasedness and Var_U(hat_tau_{p,w}) ≤ V_rob(p,w) imply Pr_U{|hat_tau_{p,w}−tau| ≤ sqrt(V_rob(p,w)/alpha)} ≥ 1−alpha for alpha in (0,1), with the zero-certificate case handled separately. Define the corresponding Chebyshev interval and call V_rob a design-computable radius-based variance bound/certificate, not an outcome-estimated variance. This adds no assumptions and remains operationally tied to the exact common-uniform covariance.

Correct the quadratic witness by reserving p for the node vector and writing the scalar covariance as Γ(u,v)={min(u,v)^2−u^2 v^2}/9 for scalar u,v (or consistently Γ(x,r) after declaring r). Correct every CortezEichhornYu2022 reference from “Theorems 1 and 2” to “Theorems 2 and 3,” anchored to pp. 5–6. In prop:class-inclusion, prove strictness with an explicit schedule having a nonzero aggregate coefficient; do not claim that scaling any nonzero unit-level schedule must violate the aggregate ellipsoid, since nonzero coefficients can aggregate to zero.

Audit two additional well-posedness points without adding substantive assumptions: state the intended parameter domain 1 ≤ β ≤ n, and do not call the joint node-weight feasible set compact because W_β(p) is unbounded when k>β. Either prove attainment by coercivity after quotienting common null directions and then retain “min,” or state the program with “inf” and keep fixed-node SDP solvability only where justified. Remove the false claim that minimum node separation uniformly bounds every polynomial-exact weight; oversampled exact-weight classes have unbounded null directions.

Update all symbols, assumptions, depends_on/used_by lists, TLDR, honest_scope, project justification, and novelty text consistently. Keep the exact covariance identity, legal least-favourable ellipsoidal schedule, block spectral certificate, and analytic node-weight frontier central. Clearly state that exact minimaxity is only over C_{n,β}(B,ω), not the full published low-order class. The revised proposal must remain non-identical and meet the field novelty floor through the exact common-uniform covariance saddle itself.
